terms.meaning: A type that is one of several possible shapes.
The specific kind of question being asked.
Looking up stored documents that might answer a question.

sections.name: Plan
sections.title: The routes a question can take
sections.what: Lists the possible routes: crew members, crew leader and my crews (database queries), retrieval for open questions, or unsupported with a reason.
sections.why: The comment says structured questions go to the database and open ones go to retrieval.
sections.watch_out: Adding a route means handling it in the answer function, or it falls through unhandled.

sections.name: Answer
sections.title: The shape of an answer
sections.what: Carries the plan, the verified sentences, the source ids and an explanation when there is nothing to say.
sections.why: The comment says empty sentences come with the explanation.
sections.watch_out: A path that returns no sentences and forgets the explanation leaves the user with a blank page.

summary: Defines the forms a planned question can take and the answer shape the page receives.
purpose: Tells the rest of the app which route a question took and what an answer contains.
why: Likely reason: fixed shapes keep routing safe and predictable.
how: 1. The plan is one of four routes: three structured intents, retrieval or unsupported. 2. The answer holds the plan, the sentences, the sources and an optional honest message.
risks: Types are checked only at build time. Consumers must check the honest message when there are no sentences.
debug: If a page shows nothing, check the honest message first.
